title: I built my first game using Codex as my assistant. Got more than I expected
author: trafleslive
selftext:
This screenshot shows an early level featuring clue-solving and tile-swapping mechanics. The goal is to create a relaxing experience that combines crossword-style clues with strategic board manipulation.

I created this game because my curiosity with AI Codex on how it can help me code this word puzzle. It turned out beautifully and more than I expected. 

I first started working on it on Godot but got stuck on a bug that i cannot fix(Swapping mechanism to be exact). Since I am just a solo developer coming from PHP, there is great adjustment and took me months but with AI Codex, the game is now better and production-ready. I was excited and proud of this game. Once I clean bugs on it, i may start a new project game. What i usually is that i make chatgpt write the codex prompt in detail of what i want before i put it into codex

Do you guys find claude better though? Or should i stick with Codex? 

Are there guys here who earns now with their ai dev game?

comments.author: florodude
comments.body:
Honestly looks decently good. Did you use an existing pack?

>  
Do you guys find claude better though? Or should i stick with Codex?

When Fable is back, *absolutely* Claude. I personally find Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.5 to be similar.

replies.author: trafleslive
replies.body:
I didnt use any packs or template. I do have experience in web designing as well but like 2 years collectively so i have an eye for design but not expert, just experienced. 

I might try Claude for my next game even though it is more expensive. I need to know or smoothen out my next game..

replies.author: florodude
replies.body:
Did GPT generate the entirety of the graphics or how did you do that?

  
One thing I *personally* do, though I understand everybody's financials is different...I have a more expensive plan for Claude then the 20/mo for ChatGPT. When there's a bug one can't solve, I let the other take a crack at it.

replies.author: trafleslive
replies.body:
What I did is that i have art packs that i created from photopea based on the images i see on internet on what my game should look like and then feed it on chatgpt to describe it and make it a codex prompt, theres several back and forth with codex on what i want to look like. 

But then you still prefer claude? As your primary.

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: Yeah I do. In general I prefer Claude for a lot of reasons, but the one that you'd probably most care about is that when I had Fable for the 3 days before it was temporarily removed (here's to hoping it comes back quickly), it's *game* changing. Things that took me all day to prompt, then add new features, then fix bugs....took like one prompt and it was off and running. I literally just started asking it questions like "What are the next 10 features you'd add" and the suggestions were better than what I was going to prioritize, and I have done actual manual gamedev.

replies.author: trafleslive
replies.body:
Now im curious with fable. Maybe it will suggest better or recommend better things for this game. Thank you stranger. Goodluck. 

Have you already earned something from game dev ai?

replies.author: florodude
replies.body: I make about 50-100/mo on a Sims mod that implements LLMs into the Sims, otherwise no!

comments.author: GlitteringJob9248
comments.body: wow, the image is really good, do u generate it by image gen or code?

replies.author: trafleslive
replies.body:
Hello

I created the art packs or the styling on photopea. Uploaded on chatgpt and then let chatgpt create a prompt for codex. Theres back and forth with codex to achieve what i want.

replies.author: GlitteringJob9248
replies.body: ok that make sense good work!
